statement: Fix a Noetherian base scheme $S$; let $\mathrm{FTS}_S$ be the category of separated schemes of finite type over $S$. For $f:X\to Y$ in this category, the *upper shriek* $f^!$ sends $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}^+(\mathcal O_Y)$ to $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}^+(\mathcal O_X)$ and is built from proper compactification $X\hookrightarrow\bar X\xrightarrow{\bar f}Y$ by $j^*a_{\bar f}$, where $a_{\bar f}$ is right adjoint to $R\bar f_*$. The corresponding *lower shriek* $Rf_!:D_{\mathrm{Coh}}^b(\mathcal O_X)\to\operatorname{Pro}(D_{\mathrm{Coh}}^b(\mathcal O_Y))$ is $R\bar f_*Rj_!$ for any compactification; proper pushforward is applied termwise to the pro-system. Let $Y$ be Noetherian and $f:X\to Y$ a local complete intersection morphism admitting an immersion $i:X\hookrightarrow P$ followed by a *proper smooth* morphism $p:P\to Y$. Locally factor $i$ as a regular immersion of codimension $c$ into an open $W\subseteq P$, with $P/Y$ smooth of relative dimension $d$; put $r=d|_X-c$, the locally constant *virtual relative dimension* on $X$. The upper-shriek structure complex is a shift of an invertible sheaf, $f^!\mathcal O_Y\simeq\omega_{X/Y}[r]$, where $\omega_{X/Y}=H^{-r}(f^!\mathcal O_Y)$ is a line bundle. With $\Omega_{X/Y}$ the sheaf of relative differentials and $\bigwedge^r=0$ when $r<0$, the conormal sequence $\mathcal I/\mathcal I^2\to\Omega_{P/Y}|_X\to\Omega_{X/Y}\to0$ induces a natural *fundamental class* map $\bigwedge^r\Omega_{X/Y}\to\omega_{X/Y}$. Its stalk at $x$ is an isomorphism iff $f$ is smooth at $x$. The map depends on the chosen regular/smooth factorization up to the noncanonicity noted in the source.
hypotheses: Y Noetherian; lci f factoring through immersion into proper smooth P/Y; local virtual dimension r.
conclusions: Fundamental class from wedge^r of relative differentials to upper-shriek line bundle is iso exactly at smooth points.
original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-fundamental-class-lci}
Let $Y$ be a Noetherian scheme. Let $f : X \to Y$ be a
local complete intersection morphism which factors
as an immersion $X \to P$ followed by a proper smooth morphism $P \to Y$.
Let $r$ be the locally constant function on
$X$ such that $\omega_{X/Y} = H^{-r}(f^!\mathcal{O}_Y)$
is the unique nonzero cohomology sheaf of $f^!\mathcal{O}_Y$, see
Lemma \ref{lemma-lci-shriek}.
Then there is a map
$$
\wedge^r\Omega_{X/Y} \longrightarrow \omega_{X/Y}
$$
which is an isomorphism on the stalk at a point $x$ if and only
if $f$ is smooth at $x$.

statement: Fix a Noetherian base scheme $S$; let $\mathrm{FTS}_S$ be the category of separated schemes of finite type over $S$. For $f:X\to Y$ in this category, the *upper shriek* $f^!$ sends $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}^+(\mathcal O_Y)$ to $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}^+(\mathcal O_X)$ and is built from proper compactification $X\hookrightarrow\bar X\xrightarrow{\bar f}Y$ by $j^*a_{\bar f}$, where $a_{\bar f}$ is right adjoint to $R\bar f_*$. The corresponding *lower shriek* $Rf_!:D_{\mathrm{Coh}}^b(\mathcal O_X)\to\operatorname{Pro}(D_{\mathrm{Coh}}^b(\mathcal O_Y))$ is $R\bar f_*Rj_!$ for any compactification; proper pushforward is applied termwise to the pro-system. Let $Y$ be Cohen–Macaulay (hence locally Noetherian), $r\ge0$, and $f:X\to Y$ a morphism factoring through an immersion $X\hookrightarrow P$ followed by a *proper smooth* map $P\to Y$. Assume (i) at every $x\in X$ with $\dim\mathcal O_{X,x}\le1$, the map $f$ is Koszul (locally a local complete intersection), and (ii) for every generic point $\xi$ of an irreducible component of $X$, $\operatorname{trdeg}_{\kappa(f(\xi))}\kappa(\xi)=r$. Define $\omega_{X/Y}=H^{-r}(f^!\mathcal O_Y)$, the coherent $(S_2)$-module in degree $-r$ of the upper-shriek structure complex. Then a morphism $\bigwedge^r\Omega_{X/Y}\to\omega_{X/Y}$ exists extending the local lci fundamental class across the complement of the lci locus, and is an isomorphism wherever $f$ is smooth. No equivalence of this map at non-smooth points is asserted.
hypotheses: CM Y, factorization immersion then proper smooth, Koszul at source points local-dim≤1, generic trdeg exactly r≥0.
conclusions: An extended fundamental-class map exists and is iso on smooth locus.
original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-fundamental-class-almost-lci}
Let $f : X \to Y$ be a morphism of schemes. Let $r \geq 0$. Assume
\begin{enumerate}
\item $Y$ is Cohen-Macaulay (Properties, Definition
\ref{properties-definition-Cohen-Macaulay}),
\item $f$ factors as $X \to P \to Y$ where the first morphism is
an immersion and the second is smooth and proper,
\item if $x \in X$ and $\dim(\mathcal{O}_{X, x}) \leq 1$,
then $f$ is Koszul at $x$ (More on Morphisms, Definition
\ref{more-morphisms-definition-lci}), and
\item if $\xi$ is a generic point of an irreducible component of $X$, then
we have
$\text{trdeg}_{\kappa(f(\xi))} \kappa(\xi) = r$.
\end{enumerate}
Then with $\omega_{X/Y} = H^{-r}(f^!\mathcal{O}_Y)$ there is a map
$$
\wedge^r\Omega_{X/Y} \longrightarrow \omega_{X/Y}
$$
which is an isomorphism on the locus where $f$ is smooth.
